Axis Robotics Announces '$AXIS': Explaining the Token Mechanism Powering Physical AI
What is currently most lacking for robots to become smarter?
It is not high-performance GPUs or larger models.
What Axis Robotics is focusing on is 'data'.

LLMs have evolved rapidly by learning from the vast amount of text and images existing on the internet. On the other hand, robots have not accumulated enough 'physical experience' data, such as grasping objects, moving, failing, and correcting in the real world.
Axis Robotics is building a 'Compounding Data Engine' that collects the data necessary for this Physical AI on a large scale and connects it to learning.
And now, '$AXIS' has been announced as the native token that supports that ecosystem.

In October 2026, a serious cyberattack occurred on the 'Onamae.com Desktop Cloud' service provided by GMO Internet.
Customer information was exfiltrated, and some users reported unauthorized transactions occurring in their financial trading accounts.
On October 19, an investigation was launched following inquiries from customers. Malicious programs were confirmed on the 20th, and servers for all plans were sequentially shut down on the 21st.

On the 24th, GMO announced condolence payments to customers, compensation for losses from unauthorized transactions, the provision of alternative services, and a fundamental overhaul of their system infrastructure.

At the same time, they made an urgent request to the government to treat this incident as the 'first activation' of active cyber defense, urging them to track, block, and neutralize the attack infrastructure.
